source: Counted from the Codex Publicus mirror of static.case.law: one metadata/CasesMetadata.json entry per case (and one json/ file) in each of the 40,622 volume zips listed in VolumesMetadata.json, with decision years from decision_date. indexed_volumes is the count of volume folders in idx.stare.pub/manifest.json (build v2026.10.18, checked 2026-10-20), whose report counts the same 6,920,598 cases.
